name: BoundingSieve.mk.congr_simp
type:
∀ (support support_1 : Finset ℕ),
  support = support_1 →
    ∀ (prodPrimes prodPrimes_1 : ℕ) (e_prodPrimes : prodPrimes = prodPrimes_1)
      (prodPrimes_squarefree : Squarefree prodPrimes) (weights weights_1 : ℕ → ℝ) (e_weights : weights = weights_1)
      (weights_nonneg : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ weights n) (totalMass totalMass_1 : ℝ),
      totalMass = totalMass_1 →
        ∀ (nu nu_1 : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (e_nu : nu = nu_1) (nu_mult : nu.IsMultiplicative)
          (nu_pos_of_prime : ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ prodPrimes → 0 < nu p)
          (nu_lt_one_of_prime : ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ prodPrimes → nu p < 1),
          { support := support, prodPrimes := prodPrimes, prodPrimes_squarefree := prodPrimes_squarefree,
              weights := weights, weights_nonneg := weights_nonneg, totalMass := totalMass, nu := nu,
              nu_mult := nu_mult, nu_pos_of_prime := nu_pos_of_prime, nu_lt_one_of_prime := nu_lt_one_of_prime } =
            { support := support_1, prodPrimes := prodPrimes_1, prodPrimes_squarefree := ⋯, weights := weights_1,
              weights_nonneg := ⋯, totalMass := totalMass_1, nu := nu_1, nu_mult := ⋯, nu_pos_of_prime := ⋯,
              nu_lt_one_of_prime := ⋯ }

name: MathlibNt.SieveTheory.BombieriVinogradov.standardPrimeAPError.eq_1
